cohort: same first 900 eligible event IDs in both members; freeze enrollment before outcome access

model.configuration: freeze exact relevant configuration at separate activation
model.fit_inputs: finalized and received before training cutoff; no future timestamps

h14_baseline.cutoff: 00:00 UTC on the preceding calendar date
h14_baseline.eligibility: final_at and available_at strictly before cutoff
h14_baseline.late_arrivals: not included retrospectively; same frozen snapshot per block

rps: sum of two squared cumulative errors / 2

bootstrap.sampling: ceil(n/21) independent block starts; concatenate then truncate to n
bootstrap.p_null: one-sided H0 mean_gain <= 0; centered resampled means
bootstrap.degenerate: constant gains produce inconclusive p=1, never approval
bootstrap.validity: approximate; requires suitable weak dependence and stationarity

decision.primary: RPS lower CI > 0 and Holm-adjusted one-sided p <= 0.05
decision.guardrails: each lower CI >= 0; uncertain interval is inconclusive
decision.interpretation: engineering decision only until prospective provenance is admitted

activation: separate immutable registration and new empty ledgers required; no scheduler installed
